items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I only knew one guy that wants to do that. There were two guys, Levi and Ray.

ctx.x: He played with Winging in Chicago, that one.

He played fine drums. I thought. He wasn't a technician, you know. In those days, you see, drumming is changed a lot. In those days, good drummers would have good solid beats, steady. Today, good drummers, the guys can play a lot of stuff. Well, I never could do that. Never. I only knew one guy that wants to do that. There were two guys, Levi and Ray. Today, they're down the top. Now, this reel's almost double with. Today, the guys fast. I think I heard the best. Joe Morello, Shadow Man.
